keywords: 私密 ERC-20 把零知识燃烧证明扩展到代币
后量子签名比现有签名大约 30 倍
summary: jakeolo 提出私密 ERC-20：把 EIP-7503 的零知识燃烧证明扩展到 ERC-20，用户把代币转到不可花费地址，再私下重新铸造。leanEthereum 宣布 PQ-Interop devnet-1 达成，实现后量子签名的签署与验证。ladislaus0x 指出后量子签名约大 30 倍，聚合更棘手。

items.title: Magicians：私密 ERC-20 的零知识燃烧
items.note: （jakeolo）17:50：把 EIP-7503 零知识燃烧证明扩展到 ERC-20，代币转入密码学上不可花费的地址后，可私下重新铸造等量代币；新增 ERC：私密 ERC-20（jakeolo）提交。
items.title_en: Magicians: Private ERC-20, zero knowledge burns for token privacy
items.note_en: (jakeolo), 17:50: extends EIP-7503 proof of burn to ERC-20, so tokens sent to cryptographically unspendable addresses can be privately re-minted; Add ERC: Private ERC-20 (jakeolo), submitted.

keywords_en: Private ERC-20 extends zero knowledge proof of burn to tokens
summary_en: jakeolo proposed Private ERC-20, extending EIP-7503 zero knowledge proof of burn to ERC-20: users send tokens to unspendable addresses and privately re-mint them. leanEthereum reached PQ-Interop devnet-1 with post-quantum signing and verification. ladislaus0x noted post-quantum signatures are about 30x larger, making aggregation harder.
